description.text: Ten single attacks (0.71 each), grants [Attach Wind] and [Essence of Wind EX Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Wind
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Wind damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Wind resistance +20%

description.name: Essence of Wind EX Mode
description.text: Grants [Physical High Quick Cast 1] to all allies in the front row after using a Wind ability, casts Inherited Swordplay 1/2/3 after using 1+3n/2+3n/3+3n Wind abilities
